from(bucket: "cnc") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "cnc_telemetry") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "event_type" or r["_field"] == "machine_status") |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "event_type", "machine_status"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
